subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers review/adopt the open fork PR at https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544, or close it and request a fresh same-repository replacement for this issue?
rationale: The source-level bug remains and the fix shape is small, but the only open closing PR is a stale, uneditable fork, so automation should not start a competing repair without maintainer direction.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing focused resolver/test patch if maintainers can refresh proof and resolve the stale fork/check state.

options.title: Request a fresh same-repo PR
options.body: Close or set aside the fork PR and ask for a new UI-only resolver fix with Control UI proof.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused resolver/test patch if maintainers can refresh proof and resolve the stale fork/check state.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent and historical connection to the Channels UI metadata/catalog path involved in the issue.
